# M3 scenario run (clean database)

*Generated by `scripts/run_m3_scenarios.py` -> `reports/m3/scenarios.json`.* Real PostgreSQL, real roles and gateway; customer systems are deterministic mocks; identities are mock signed claims; no model is involved.

| group | scenario | expected | actual | |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Absolute invariants (checked over everything above)

| invariant | result | detail |
|---|---|---|
| I1 no gated action without approval | PASS | 7 effects applied across all customer systems; 0 not backed by an approved, role-matching, hash-matching approval |
| I2 no cross-tenant exposure | PASS | 0 control rows whose account differs from their case's account |
| I3 no customer email | PASS | 1 escalation destinations, all internal; 1 drafts, all in 'draft' state; the control package has no email/network capability (static test) |
| I4 no secret in logs/audit | PASS | canaries found in audit/approvals/ledger/events: none |
| audit chain intact | PASS | 102 events verified |

Attack catalogue: 61 of 68 attacks executable; still planned: A-I1-07, A-I2-06, A-I2-07, A-I2-10, A-I3-04, A-I3-05, A-I4-02.
